notes: Read all 52 source lines before editing and preserved tripKeys, UseTripParams, query key shapes, parameter inclusion guards, /trips list path, AbortSignal forwarding, and safeArray select behavior.
Source is non-visual API/type code; the native output uses the React Native-safe web-parity request client with no DOM modules, browser elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI imports.

Inlined the Trip interface and safeArray guard because the native web-parity hook layer does not expose the web @/api/types or @/lib/safeArray aliases; SI fields total_distance_m, total_energy_wh, and total_duration_s remain raw and unconverted in the hook.

Preserved the deprecated useTrip /trips/{id} request, enabled guard, and 404-through-query-error behavior; URLSearchParams.set was adapted to append because each key is emitted at most once and existing native parity hooks use append.
